desc:
🍎 Grab Apples from the Giant Pile!
🔪 Peel them and cook Slices, Caramel Apples & Pies!
💰 Serve Customers at the Window!
⬆️ Upgrade your Farm with Machines & a Robot Helper!
🗝️ Dig through the Pile to find the Key and Escape!

🌙 But be careful when Night falls... someone is watching 👀

👍 Like & Favorite if you had fun! 🔥
